The objective of the Doctor Connect project is to develop a web based platform that facilitates seamless

CARE CONNECT 2025 
Care Connect is an AI-driven, multilingual healthcare chatbot developed for the Odisha Government to enhance 
public health accessibility. It offers symptom checking, vaccination reminders, maternal care guidance, and real-
time outbreak alerts through voice, text, and avatar-based interactions. Built with Flask, Lang Chain, MongoDB, 
Chroma DB, and OpenAI models, it bridges the gap between citizens and healthcare services—especially in rural 
regions—by promoting disease awareness and preventive care. 
Tech Stack: HTML, JavaScript, Flask, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Lang Chain, OpenAI 
SafePath – Route Safety Awareness System 
SafePath – Women Safety Route Awareness System is a web-based prototype developed to improve women’s safety 
awareness during travel. The system allows users to select a starting location and destination, and it displays routes 
categorized as safe, moderate, or unsafe based on pre-stored data. It includes features such as an emergency alert 
button, simulated location sharing, safety tips, and a user feedback mechanism to mark areas as safe or unsafe. The 
project is implemented using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, making it a simple, cost-effective, and user-friendly 
solution. It focuses on providing preventive safety awareness rather than complex real-time tracking, helping users 
make informed decisions and travel with greater confidence. 
SeaShield-SeaShield is a coastal safety application designed to help fishermen avoid crossing maritime boundaries 
by using offline geo -fencing technology. The system provides location-based alerts even in no -network conditions, 
enabling safer navigation in remote sea areas. It also includes a responsive interface,secure authentication, and scalable 
backend support to deliver reliable and practical assistance for coastal user .Tech stack: MERN Stack (MongoDB, 
Express.js, React.js, Node.js), HTML, CSS, JavaScript
